champions.name: Champions & Advocates
champions.description: Positive sentiment and sustained/growing purchase velocity. Low churn probability.

silent_churn.name: Silent Churn Risk
silent_churn.description: Pleased in reviews, but purchases/sessions have dropped significantly. Silent disengagement.

vocal_loyalists.name: Vocal Loyalists

detractors.name: Detractors at Severe Risk
